candidates.transcript_evidence: So, for example, in countries such as the United States, the UK, Mexico, and China, if you make this hand sign, it's typically to show that you're okay.

candidates.transcript_evidence: It's a sign to show everything's fine, all right.

candidates.transcript_evidence: Have you, in your memory, ever used this in daily interactions or when talking to another person?
candidates.description: 询问记忆中是否曾在日常互动中使用过该手势

candidates.transcript_evidence: And if you have ever used the okay symbol, do you remember how people would have responded to it?
candidates.description: 询问如果使用过该手势，是否记得他人的反应
